row: QA-17 - the title field is the only contenteditable at rest, no description input by default

todoist.note: Composer at rest is a single tiptap ProseMirror contenteditable with aria-label='Task name'; no separate description field is present until 'More actions' or a dedicated affordance is used. Confirmed by direct inspection of the composer's outerHTML while typing (single <div contenteditable> node throughout QA-02 through QA-15 testing) - no second contenteditable ever appeared.

verdict: matched - single contenteditable title field at rest, no description input, in both apps
